the cluster network is a complex web of relations that can be divided into permanent and temporary proximitiesthrough the lens of the three proximity kinds, and that ITFs are a means of interconnecting these kinds of proximities.

the question of whether the participation at ITFs is a way to overcome the limits of the cluster.
the role of ITFs in the creation, maintenance, and development of clusters.
how firms in clusters can be linked through permanent, temporary, and relational proximity.

ITFs are not only important for the local cluster network, but they can also be important for the global network.

international trade fairs can be seen as an amplifier for the permanent proximity of the cluster network and as a facilitator for the temporary proximity of the cluster.
